name: io.github.noobshole/svalin-mcp
title: Svalin
description: Read-only Solana and NEAR wallet risk reports for AI agents, paid per call in USDC over x402.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Svalin API to call.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base58 key of a dedicated hot wallet holding a few USDC on Solana. Enables paid tools.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_NEAR_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. NEAR account that pays, e.g. my-agent.near. Set together with SVALIN_NEAR_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_NEAR_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. ed25519:… key of that account (a dedicated wallet holding a few USDC on NEAR). Enables paid tools.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_NEAR_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional NEAR RPC endpoint used to build payments.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_PREFERRED_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: solana or near, when both wallets are set.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap per paid call, in USD.

environmentVariables.name: SVALIN_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard spending cap per MCP session, in USD.
